name: REPT BATTERO Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: REPT BATTERO Energy Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research and development, production, and sale of electric vehicle and energy storage system lithium-ion batteries in China and internationally. The company offers battery cell products, such as utility and C&I ESS series, residential ESS series, BEV series, PHEV and REEV series, and commercial vehicle series, as well as LFP battery cells, ternary battery cells, and EV battery modules; and battery pack products, including energy storage battery packs, passenger vehicle battery packs, and commercial vehicle battery pack and rack.
